summary: Tested NEW notification APIs and frontend features for Bricks Dispatch. Backend 100% pass (28/28 tests including 7 new notification tests). Frontend 90% success - all notification features working, BRICKS DISPATCH wordmark visible, notification bell with unread badge visible, all core flows functional. Known Expo Router tab overlay issue persists but less severe than iteration 2.

integration_issues.flow: Tab navigation after job detail view
integration_issues.issue: After navigating to job detail and attempting to navigate to other tabs, tab text elements become not visible/clickable
integration_issues.details: This appears to be related to the known Expo Router tab overlay issue. After viewing job detail, the Profile tab text element is not visible for clicking. This is a manifestation of the React Native Web z-index/stacking issue documented in previous iterations.

react_native_issues.component: Expo Router Tabs - Screen stacking on React Native Web
react_native_issues.issue: Tab navigation has visibility issues after navigating to job detail screen
react_native_issues.details: Related to the known Expo Router Tabs z-index issue on React Native Web (GitHub #25958). Less severe than iteration 2 where Uploads and Profile screens remained as full overlays. Now manifests as tab element visibility issues.

action_items: Continue monitoring Expo Router tab overlay issue - appears less severe than iteration 2
Consider implementing the recommended fixes from iteration 2: switch to NativeTabs or portal-based overlay system

context_for_next_testing_agent: All notification features are working correctly. Backend 100% pass with 7 new notification API tests. Frontend notification bell with unread badge (showing '4') is visible and working. BRICKS DISPATCH wordmark is properly displayed. The Expo Router tab overlay issue from iteration 2 appears less severe - now manifests as tab element visibility issues rather than full screen overlays. All core functionality (jobs list, filters, job detail, schedule, uploads, profile) is working. Completed jobs correctly don't show action buttons.

expo_router_overlay_issue_status.current_behavior: Tab text elements become not visible after navigating to job detail, preventing further tab navigation
expo_router_overlay_issue_status.previous_behavior_iteration_2: Uploads and Profile screens remained as full overlays blocking all interactions
expo_router_overlay_issue_status.improvement: Issue is less severe - no longer full screen overlays, just tab element visibility problems
expo_router_overlay_issue_status.workaround: Reload page to reset navigation state
expo_router_overlay_issue_status.recommended_fix: Switch to NativeTabs from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' or implement portal-based overlay system
